{"answers":{"v02":"Precision judges the quality of what you returned; recall judges how much of what exists you returned. Say the library holds 20 relevant papers for your query, and the search engine shows 10 results of which 6 are truly relevant. Precision = 6/10 = 60%: of the results shown, the share worth showing. Recall = 6/20 = 30%: of all relevant papers, the share you surfaced. Precision describes the list you see; recall describes the one you don't. Change one condition: lower the matching threshold so it returns 40 results, 12 relevant. Precision drops to 30% (more junk) while recall rises to 60% (fewer missed) — widening the net catches more fish and more trash, so the two trade off. Prefer precision when a false alarm is costly (spam filters, doctor alerts); prefer recall when a miss is costly (cancer screening, legal discovery). Note the failure mode: returning 1 perfect result gives 100% precision but 5% recall — flawless quality, useless coverage. One number alone can hide a broken system.","v07":"路灯是典型的公共物品：多一个人走夜路，不减少别人得到的光亮（非竞争性）；也没法只让交钱的人享有照明、让不交钱的人摸黑（非排他性）。这两个性质合起来制造了搭便车。一栋楼十户凑钱装路灯，总成本 2000 元，每户受益都值 300 元。张三盘算：我一分不交，灯照样亮，我照样受益——不交反而是占便宜的选择。每户都这么算，2000 元收不上来，灯装不成，十户各损失 300 元。这就是公共物品市场供给不足的原因：企业无法向路人逐个收照明费，自然不肯建。注意，供给不足不等于没人需要，而是谁受益谁付费的机制失效了，所以现实常由政府用税收统一提供——强制分摊把搭便车者也算进缴费名单。用对照看清边界：包子是私人物品，不付钱拿不到，市场供给良好；天气预报、开源软件同样难排除不付费者，所以靠税收或捐赠支撑。改变条件：一旦排他变得便宜（如加密频道收费），公共物品就变成可收费的物品，市场就能接手。","v05":"信息熵衡量结果揭晓之前你有多拿不准。均匀硬币正反各 50%，熵 = −(0.5·log0.5 + 0.5·log0.5) = 1 比特；调成正面 90%、反面 10%，熵降到约 0.47 比特。算法是把每个结果的概率乘 log(1/p) 再求和：概率小的结果出现时更意外，但很少出现，平均贡献小。为什么均匀分布最不确定？关键在于偏向本身就是信息：硬币一旦偏向正面 90%，你连猜十次能对九次——分布的偏向在告诉你该预期什么，不确定性随之下降。均匀分布是唯一毫无偏向的分布，每个结果同等可能，你没有理由多押任何一个，这正是拿不准的顶点；数学上可证，结果数固定时 −Σp·log p 在所有 p 相等处取最大值。改变条件：均匀六面骰的熵约 2.58 比特，高于均匀硬币——可选结果越多且越均匀，越难猜中。注意熵算出的是不确定性这个量；你关心的具体判断（该押哪面）仍要比较各结果的概率。","d07":"夏天冰淇淋销量与溺水人数一起涨跌，相关系数可能很高，但吃冰淇淋不会淹死人。真正的原因是第三变量：天气热，既让人多买冰淇淋，也让人多去游泳，游泳多了溺水才多。冰淇淋和溺水是同一原因结出的两个果，它们相关，却没有因果箭头相连。这就是相关不等于因果最常见的形态：A 与 B 相关，可能是 A 导致 B，可能是 B 导致 A，可能是 C 同时导致 A 和 B，甚至纯属巧合。区分的办法是干预：只限制冰淇淋销量，看溺水动不动。没人少游泳，溺水也不变，就排除了冰淇淋的因果作用；随机对照试验是这个思路的严格版——随机分组让天气偏好等因素在两组间均等，剩下的差异只能来自处理本身。换个情境检验判断依据：儿童鞋码与阅读能力高度相关，第三变量是年龄；固定年龄再比较，相关基本消失。要害始终是：找到并控制共同原因，或主动干预只动一个变量。","d04":"Opportunity cost is the value of the best option you gave up — not all options, just the top one. Your free afternoon has three uses: nap, study for Monday's exam, or earn ¥150 at a part-time shift. If you nap, your opportunity cost is ¥150, the most valuable thing sacrificed. The forgone studying doesn't add on top, because you could only have done one; opportunity cost counts the single best alternative. If you take the shift instead, the cost flips: it's the exam prep you skipped, worth whatever a better grade means to you. So nothing is truly free — the 'free' afternoon costs its best alternative however you spend it, including scrolling your phone. Change one condition: if the exam is tomorrow, studying becomes more valuable, and the same nap now costs much more. One boundary: the score you already lost last week doesn't enter the calculation — that would be a sunk cost, not an opportunity cost.","v04":"Idempotency means performing the same operation twice leaves the system state the same as performing it once. `SET status = 'shipped'` is idempotent — call it five times, status is still 'shipped'. `balance += 100` is not — five calls add 500. Distributed systems make this matter because networks retry: a payment request times out, the client can't tell whether the server processed it, so it resends. If processing isn't idempotent, the customer is charged twice. The standard fix is an idempotency key: the client attaches a unique ID to each logical operation; the server stores the key with its result and, on a duplicate, returns the stored response instead of executing again. That turns a non-idempotent action (charge the card) into an idempotent request (process charge #abc123). Two clarifications: idempotency is about state, not response bodies — a second DELETE returning 404 is still idempotent because the resource is gone either way; and it is scoped to the declared operation, so the same endpoint may be idempotent for PUT but not for POST unless you add keys.","d05":"检测呈阳性，真患病的概率是多少？直觉答「检测准确率 99%，那差不多就是 99%」，贝叶斯公式给出完全不同的数。设定：患病率 1%，灵敏度 99%（病人九成九检出阳性），健康人也有 5% 误报。公式：P(患病|阳性) = P(阳性|患病)×P(患病) ÷ P(阳性)。分子是「病人且被检出」的份额，分母是「所有呈阳性的人」的份额。用一万人算：100 人患病，99 人检出；9900 人健康，495 人误报。阳性共 594 人，真病人占 99/594 ≈ 17%。直觉错在哪？分母里挤进了海量健康人的误报——患病率很低时，阳性队伍里健康人反而占多数。公式里的 P(患病)=1% 是先验，它把你从只看这一次检测，拉回到结合人群底数来看。改变条件：患病率若升到 10%，同样的检测算出 0.099/(0.099+0.045) ≈ 69%——底数越高，同样的阳性越可信。这也解释了筛查为什么要复检：第一次阳性把概率从 1% 提到 17%，拿 17% 当新的底数再算一次，概率就大幅上升。","d06":"A cache keeps a copy of data close by so requests skip the slow original — but a copy goes stale when the original changes. Cache invalidation is removing or refreshing stale copies. Your product page reads 'price of item #7' from the database on every visit; you cache the answer for an hour and 10,000 visits skip the database. The merchant then cuts the price — until something happens, visitors see the old number. Options: (1) TTL — accept staleness and let the entry expire; simple, wrong in the gap. (2) Invalidate on write — when the price updates, delete the cached key 'price:7'; the next visitor re-fetches fresh data. Accurate, but every write path must do it, including admin tools and batch jobs, or the stale copy survives. This is why invalidation is famously hard: the same data may sit in many places — browser, CDN, app server — and one write must reach them all. The rule of thumb: tolerated staleness picks the mechanism — prices users compare need write-time invalidation; view counts can live with a TTL.","v08":"Little's law: L = λW — the average number of items in a system equals the arrival rate times the average time each spends inside. Coffee shop: 10 customers arrive per minute (λ = 10/min) and each stays 4 minutes on average from joining the line to leaving (W = 4 min), so L = 40 customers inside at a typical moment. Why multiply? Each arrival deposits one person for the length of their stay, so stock = deposit rate × deposit duration — like a bathtub: water volume = inflow rate × time to drain. Units confirm it: per-minute × minutes = people. The law's power is that it holds for any stable queue regardless of arrival pattern or queue discipline, so you can measure any two quantities and derive the third. A server holding 200 concurrent requests (L) while completing 1,000 requests/s (λ) must average W = 0.2 s. Validity requires stability — arrivals must not exceed capacity; otherwise the queue grows without bound and no steady-state relationship holds.","v06":"Deadlock: threads each hold resources and each wait for another's, so none can ever proceed. Thread 1 locks file A, then wants database lock B; Thread 2 locks B, then wants A. Each holds one while waiting for the other, and neither releases while blocked — both wait forever. Four conditions must hold simultaneously: mutual exclusion (one holder at a time), hold-and-wait (keeping resources while requesting more), no preemption (resources can't be forcibly taken), and circular wait (the waiting forms a ring). Break any one and deadlock becomes impossible. The cheapest break is circular wait: number all locks and require every thread to acquire them in increasing order — both threads then lock A before B, so Thread 2 waits for A, Thread 1 finishes and releases everything. If prevention doesn't fit your system, detect the cycle and kill one victim thread to free its resources; lock timeouts are a blunt version of this — give up, release everything, retry.","d02":"Two datasets can share an average yet differ wildly in spread: {4, 5, 6} and {0, 5, 10} both average 5, but the first hugs it and the second swings far. Population variance measures that spread: take each value's distance from the mean, square it, average the squares. {4,5,6}: deviations −1, 0, 1; squares 1, 0, 1; variance = 2/3. {0,5,10}: deviations −5, 0, 5; squares 25, 0, 25; variance = 50/3 ≈ 16.7. Same mean, twenty-five times the spread. Why square? Raw deviations always sum to zero — positives cancel negatives — so averaging them gives a useless 0; squaring makes every term positive. That's a choice with a cost: a deviation of 5 weighs 25 times a deviation of 1, so far-out points dominate the result. Two follow-ups: units get squared (prices in yuan give variance in yuan²), so the square root — the standard deviation — returns to yuan; and dividing by N defines the population version, while estimating from a sample divides by n−1 to correct the usual underestimate.","v03":"自然选择的分工是：变异随机产生，环境只负责筛选，个体没有「想变就变」的能力。以长颈鹿为例——不是每只鹿努力伸脖子、把脖子练长再传给后代，而是鹿群里本来就有随机差异：有的天生脖子稍长。干旱来临时低处叶子吃光，脖子长的够到高处，吃得多、活得久、留下更多后代；它们的下一代里，长脖子的比例升高。种群就这样一代代改变——注意，变的是群体的基因频率，不是某只鹿的脖子。拉马克式「用进废退」把因果讲反了：不是使用导致性状出现，而是现成性状决定谁能繁殖。变异的方向也是随机的：环境不会指挥细菌生成抗药基因，而是用药前细菌群里碰巧已有少数抗药变异，抗生素把不抗药的杀光，抗药的失去竞争者大量繁殖。由此有个现实推论：选择只能在已有变异里挑，速度受繁殖代数限制。所以果树育种靠诱变或杂交先制造随机变异，而不是让果树「努力」变得抗病。","d03":"正反馈是输出回过头加强输入的循环：变化 A 引起 B，B 又推动 A 更进一步。麦克风对着音箱是最直观的例子：话筒拾到一点声音，音箱放大播出，更响的声音又被拾进去，再放大——几秒内啸叫刺耳。每绕一圈，信号乘上一个大于 1 的倍数，变化因此指数式放大，这就是正反馈放大变化的机制。先分清两件事：正与负只描述方向，不评价好坏。负反馈是输出反过来压制输入，像恒温器把温度拉回设定值，系统趋于稳定；正反馈则离原点越来越远。好与坏取决于被放大的是什么。复利是好的版本：利息并入本金再生息，同样的放大结构让财富加速增长；同一结构作用在债务上就是利滚利的灾难。抢购与挤兑是坏版本：「别人在抢」促使更多人抢，货架几小时清空。遇到正反馈先问两句：回路放大的是你期望的方向吗？放大有没有上限？啸叫最终被音响功率极限或拔插头打断——看清回路，才知道该在哪个环节切断或利用它。","d08":"Compound growth means growth earns growth: each period's increase is added to the base, so the next period grows from a bigger number. Formula: final = start × (1+r)^t. $1,000 at 7% a year reaches about $1,967 in 10 years and $7,612 in 30 — the jumps accelerate because the same percentage applies to an ever-larger base. Why the starting amount matters: compounding is multiplication, so everything scales with the initial base. $10,000 and $1,000 grow at the identical rate, ending at $76,123 versus $7,612. The ratio stays 10×, but the absolute gap widens from $9,000 to $68,511 — the bigger base earns more dollars per year at the same percentage. That's why growing the base early beats chasing the rate: time sits in the exponent. Caveats: the formula assumes a constant rate and untouched principal. Real returns vary, losses compound too — down 50% needs up 100% to recover — and withdrawals break the reinvestment loop that makes compounding work.","d01":"似然回答「假设这个假设为真，看到眼前这批数据的概率多大」；后验概率回答「看过数据之后，这个假设为真的概率多大」。一个从假设推数据，一个从数据推假设，方向相反。抛硬币：假设 A 是「硬币均匀」，连抛三次全正面，A 下这批数据的似然 L(A) = 0.5³ = 0.125。注意它不是「硬币均匀的概率」——似然是数据在假设下的属性，用来比较不同假设对同一批数据的解释力：假设 B「两面都是正面」的似然是 1，比 A 更能解释这三次。要得到后验必须补上先验，用贝叶斯公式：后验 ∝ 似然 × 先验。设抛前你对 A、B 各信一半，则 P(A|三次正面) = 0.5×0.125 ÷ (0.5×0.125 + 0.5×1) ≈ 11%。似然提供证据，先验提供出发点，后验才是看过数据后该信的。容易踩的坑：似然 0.125 很小，不代表 A 大概率为假——若先验里 B 几乎不可能，后验仍站在 A 一边；有限数据只会重新分配信念，不会单独证实或证伪。","v01":"过拟合是模型把训练数据的「考题原样」背了下来，而不是学会解题方法——遇到没见过的题就露馅。设想给学生一万道历史题练习：一个学生总结出「年代、因果、影响」的答题框架，新题也能答；另一个把每题答案连标点背下，练习册满分，换套新题一塌糊涂。后者就是过拟合的模型。机器学习用到的数据总含两部分：会重复出现的规律，和这批数据特有的噪声。模型越复杂、训练越久，越有能力连噪声一起记住——这在训练数据上仍显得准确，因为答案确实对上了，但对新数据无效。于是出现典型的分离：训练准确率一路上升，新数据上的准确率先升后降。判断和应对都围绕这个分离：留一部分数据不参与训练，专门检验真实水平；确认过拟合后，用更简单的模型、更多数据或正则化压制「背题」的自由度。一句话的判断依据：模型该记住的是会重复的模式，不是每条数据的偶然细节。"}}
